## Description

Write a concise description of the runtime performance improvements that need to be made.

## Current state

Describe the current state of the relevant non-functional quality attributes, such as security, scalability, reliability, latency, usability, and availability. If possible, provide current performance metrics, such as response time, throughput, CPU usage.

## Desired state

Define the criteria for considering the performance improvements to be successful. If possible, specify measurable performance metrics.

## Proposed solutions

Outline the steps or strategies for achieving the desired performance improvements. Mention any tools, techniques, or methodologies to be used, such as code profiling, load testing, refactoring, or security audits.

## Impact

List the components or modules that are expected to be need to be changed to achieve the desired performance improvements. Identify any dependencies that need to be considered, too.

## Risks

Identify potential risks and describe mitigation strategies.

## Validation

Describe the testing strategy that will be used to validate the improvements, eg. benchmarking, stress tests, security tests. Establish a baseline for comparison.

## Additional notes

Add any other context, background information, or references that might be helpful in understanding the requirements.
